improvements.areaName: SEO Meta Description and OG Tags
improvements.suggestion:
<meta name="description" content="Gideon is your Claude-powered AI assistant for trade and business. Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support. Try three free searches, then unlock unlimited access from US$2/day.">
<meta property="og:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | Your AI Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta property="og:description" content="Claude-powered AI assistant for business owners, traders, and professionals. Instant answers, voice chat, and unlimited workspace access. Start with three free searches.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:site_name" content="GDN AI">
improvements.rationale: A clear meta description improves click-through rates from search results by communicating the core value prop (Claude-powered AI assistant), target audience (trade and business), and offer (three free searches, membership from US$2/day). Open Graph tags ensure professional, consistent previews when shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, and other platforms—critical for B2B trust and social traffic.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Partner"

Subheading: "Meet Gideon — the intelligent assistant built for business owners, traders, and professionals. Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a dedicated workspace to streamline your operations. Try three free searches now."
improvements.rationale: This headline positions Gideon as a partner rather than just a tool, building trust and relatability. The subheading clearly communicates the target audience, key features (instant answers, voice chat, workspace), and the low-friction entry point (three free searches). The call-to-action is embedded naturally, encouraging immediate engagement without pressure.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to become a member. Membership starts at just US$2 per day, giving you unlimited access to Gideon's full capabilities—including voice chat, your personal workspace, and professional trade and business support. Choose annual billing to save 30 percent.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in a freemium model: what happens when the trial ends. By clearly explaining the transition and reinforcing the low entry price and value, it reduces uncertainty and encourages conversion.
